rule: Stage 6 reports against the 59 locked bars (version/test_table.json); the north-star bars and the walk rows are older lists mapped onto them here (steward decision, journal question 4).
made_by: make_bar_map.py (throwaway; north-star from tree.json leaf roots, walk rows by hand)

walk.row: A Bomb blast (mortar, r 2.9) one cell from a human throws them 3 cells straight away from the centre, alive (owner Q7).
A wall behind the pawn stops the throw on the cell before it, with impact damage.
A closed door stops the throw like a wall and takes a hit.
Pawns are thrown over sandbags and barricades (owner Q3).

A living creature heavier than the creature mass limit (150 kg, the game's Mass stat less carried inventory; owner card 2026-11-13) is not thrown: a 220-260 kg animal, chosen by mass from the loaded animals, journals too_heavy_creature.
EMP (and every zero-force blast) throws nothing and enqueues nothing.
Light items are thrown by the same kernel (lighter flies farther, stack intact); an item over 75 kg stays (owner Q4).
An item on an open shelf scatters; an item in a closed container stays.
A pawn the blast kills is thrown as a corpse.
Thrown goods truly fly (RIMMANDRAKE_FLY_KNOCKBACK_GOODS_WILD): mid-flight the stack is inside a carrier, count intact.
A flown stack lands on the cell the instant move would choose, count intact, no carrier left.
A flight cut short by a wall (rebound off) lands beside it and takes today's wall impact there.
With rebound on, a cut-short flight bounces back with about 70% of the cells it had left; the impact applies at the bounce.
flyingGoods off: loose goods and corpses are not thrown at all, never the old instant move (the bar settings_scale_and_switch wins).
walk.note: Corrected to the bar 2026-11-15 (blind cycle 2, steward's decision 8): the row said flyingGoods off was the old instant move; the locked bar settings_scale_and_switch says goods in the air off means loose goods are not thrown at all, never the old hop. The code follows the bar (skip flying_off).

walk.row: A closed container (a stasis locker, a sealed crate) that survives the blast is thrown whole, shorter than the same goods loose, its goods still in it and unhurt by the blast (owner 2026-11-12).
A flying stack of 10 kg or more that reaches a person hits them lightly, staggers them and drops there; a light stack flies past.
A thrown stack never shoves a stack already lying where it lands (a stackLimit-1 thing into a full cell lands beside it).
walk.note: UNMAPPED: no locked bar says a thrown stack never shoves a stack already on its landing cell.

walk.row: The same in a pit: a good already on the pit floor stays there when a thrown thing lands on its cell.
walk.note: UNMAPPED: inv_pit_floor_goods_stay is about the blast not throwing pit-floor goods, not about a landing pushing them out.

walk.row: Burning flammable gas (the Cauldron's vent gas) goes off clump by clump: a burst per burning cell over several ticks, goods at most 2 cells, people shoved 1 cell with no shove damage and at most once per 2 s, no pit cover damaged.
Fire and incendiary blasts throw at half a Bomb's force (owner card 2026-11-11).
A damaging explosion this mod does not patch throws at full force by default (owner card 2026-11-11).
A save taken mid-flight reloads with the carrier and its stack, which then lands intact.
A colonist thrown into an open pit lands on its floor and FlowWorks records exactly one descent.
An enemy thrown into an open pit lands on its floor and falls (one descent).
Nothing is thrown across a pit: a throw stops IN the first open pit cell.
A pawn already in a pit is never thrown (you can't climb out).
A corpse thrown toward a pit lies on the pit floor (owner Q10).
A damaging blast that reaches a pit cover breaks the whole deck and anyone on it falls (owner Q5/Q9, FlowWorks).
No cap (owner 2026-11-12, "No caps please."): a 5.9 blast over 10 people and 80 stacks throws every one it reaches, all item throws in the one tick the wave lands (over the old 40 and 60 caps).
Master switch off: the blast still damages, nothing moves.
A projectile ThingDef's own knockback extension beats its DamageDef's, and the request journal names the source (design §2.1 lookup: projectile → weapon → DamageDef → unpatched).
An explicit force 0 on the projectile wins over a DamageDef that throws: nothing is requested.
A blast with impactFactor 0 stops at a wall with zero impact damage.
A blast with creatureMassLimitOverride 216 (the grav-ram's) throws a 160-200 kg animal chosen by mass; a plain Bomb beside the same kind does not (too_heavy_creature).

Heavier flies less, and a bigger blast throws farther (owner cards 2026-11-13, sc_mass_and_power): one Bomb r 2.9 at damage 50 one cell from the lightest loaded animal, a colonist (45-76 kg), the heaviest animal under 150 kg and a 220-260 kg animal (all chosen by mass; the row prints each label and measured mass) throws each the kernel's cells for its mass (12 / 70 / 144 / 240 kg: 5 / 3 / 2 / spared).
The same blast at damage 100 throws 6 (the cap) / 5 / 4 / spared, damage ratio 2.0.
With "Bigger blasts throw harder" off, damage 50 throws 5 / 3 / 2 / spared.
With it off, damage 100 throws the same as damage 50 (ratio 1.0).
With the creature mass limit at 250 kg, damage 50 throws the 220-260 kg animal (240 kg: 1 cell).
With the limit at 250 kg, damage 100 throws the 220-260 kg animal farther (240 kg: 3 cells).
A pawn thrown once cannot be thrown again until its landing stun ends plus the recovery window: a second blast inside it journals "immune" and does not move it.
A shield belt that absorbs a blast absorbs the throw: the wearer does not move, and the belt loses extra charge (owner Q4).
The recovery-window stamps survive a save/reload.
A colonist carrying a hose end drops it where they stood (owner Q6).
A flyer saved mid-air reloads with the pawn existing once.
Raiders resume their lord's duty after landing.
walk.note: PARTIAL: pawn_flight_arc says the thrown pawn goes back to what it was doing; a raider's lord duty is that case, but no scene of the 59 stages a raider.

walk.row: Results are the same with VEF active (it patches PawnFlyer).
walk.note: UNMAPPED: no locked bar names VEF (it patches PawnFlyer).

walk.row: A barrage costs little per tick.
Items/corpses on a pit floor can be hauled out by colonists (owner Q10 "stay retrievable").
